title: specy-road orchestration contract
description: roadmap/orchestration.yaml: who may coordinate, execute, and review leaves, and what the implementation review gate requires. A missing file means the default policy (one reviewer, any family, roster of one human).

roster.description: Models (and humans) that may hold a role. A review counts toward the gate only when its model is rostered with the reviewer role, or is the substitute in an active substitution for that node.

substitutions.description: Recorded decisions to let a named substitute fill a reviewer slot, with a date and an expiry.

id.description: Model id as used in review records (e.g. claude-opus-5.5, human).

family.description: Vendor family; reviewer independence is judged by family (e.g. anthropic, openai, human).

profile.description: Repo-relative path to this model's profile (model-profiles/<family>/<api_id>.md).

harness.description: Which vendor harness `specy-road worker delegate` runs this model on (generic runs the profile's access.cli). Distinct from the model: a Claude model under Cursor's agent is a cursor worker.

billing_route.description: Label for whose quota a worker on this entry draws (e.g. claude_subscription, chatgpt_oauth, api_key). Recorded on the worker; never used to authenticate.

cli.description: Headless invocation; {prompt} is replaced with the prompt file path.

cli_resume.description: Command worker message and resume run instead of cli, with the launch's permissions: names {session} (or {session_flag} on claude-code) and {prompt}, e.g. codex exec resume --json ... {session} - < {prompt}.

paste.description: Name of the IDE chat a prompt file is pasted into.

may_process.description: Data sensitivity levels this model may receive (e.g. public, internal, restricted). Absent means [public]; an explicit [] lets it process nothing.

subagent_family_lock.description: When set, this model may spawn only sub-agents of this family.

class.description: Executor class tag a leaf's executor_eligibility can name (e.g. senior, cheap).

public_key.description: OpenSSH public key line this reviewer signs records with; required for its reviews to count when policy.signed_reviews is true.

unavailable_until.description: Legacy capacity pause through this date (inclusive); prefer paused_until.

available.description: When false, orchestrate plan and delegate skip this entry until it is true again.

paused_until.description: Skip through this calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) or datetime (ISO 8601) without removing the roster entry.

preflight.description: Command that must succeed before a prompt is sent to this model.

reviewers_required.description: Approving review records at the branch HEAD needed before mark-implementation-reviewed succeeds. Default 1.

reviewers_distinct_families.description: When true, the approvals must come from that many distinct families. Default false.

reviewer_fresh_session.description: When true, a review record must attest it came from a fresh session. Default true.

signed_reviews.description: When true, a review record counts only if it carries a signature that verifies against its roster entry's public_key. Default false.

reviewer_reruns_required.description: When true, an approving review record counts only if its commands_rerun lists at least one command the reviewer re-ran. A human's interactive approval is exempt; a block is never affected. Default false.

max_workers.description: Most workers `specy-road worker delegate` keeps active at once; each draws on a plan quota. Default 2.

escalate_same_acceptance_blocks.description: A leaf's review loop is escalated for root-cause analysis when this many consecutive review rounds block on the same acceptance id. Default 3.

escalate_review_rounds.description: A leaf's review loop is escalated for root-cause analysis after this many review rounds since its last analysis. Default 5.

stall_after_seconds.description: A running worker with no harness stdout for this many seconds is flagged stalled by `worker sync` and `worker list`, with one stalled event per silence. Default 600.

milestone_full_review.description: When true, a milestone (a node with leaf children) is not set to Complete when its last leaf finishes until a full review of its combined change (the first leaf's branch point to the integration tip) passes the review gate at that tip; `review-packet <MILESTONE_ID>` builds the packet and `mark-implementation-reviewed <MILESTONE_ID>` closes it. Default true.

integrity_gate.description: When true, each `specy-road integrity` finding for the commit under review is a review-gate problem unless its exact line is in the node's planned_test_changes as committed on the integration branch. Default false.

delta_review.description: When true, a fix round after a reviewer's approval may be reviewed from a delta packet (`work/reviews/<NODE_ID>/PACKET-<model>.md`: the diff since the last commit that reviewer approved, plus its notes on that commit) when every path in that delta is a documentation or test file inside the leaf's touch zones (the leaf's own implementation summary counts as inside), it touches at most three files, and its integrity report has no findings; otherwise the round gets the full packet. An approval naming delta_from counts only for the model whose counting approval of that commit is on file, and only while the delta still qualifies. `review-packet --full` skips delta packets; false forces full review. Default true.

reviewer_resumed_delta.description: When true, reviewer_fresh_session is waived for a record naming delta_from: the reviewer that approved delta_from may be resumed in that same session to review the delta since and file fresh_session: false. Such an approval still counts only under the delta_review rules; a resumed full review, and any other record with fresh_session: false, is still refused. Default false.

red_green.description: When true, every Python test function the leaf adds or changes must fail at the merge base (with the head's changed test files overlaid) and pass at head, or pass on both when the node's planned_test_changes on the integration branch lists it as `preserve: <path>::<name>`; `specy-road review red-green` records the outcomes in work/reviews/<NODE_ID>/RED-GREEN.md and the review gate reads them for the commit under review. Default false.

ratchet_paths.description: Git-root-relative paths of baseline files (clone, lint, mutation or size baselines) that a leaf may only shrink. `specy-road integrity` prints `baseline-widened: <path> +<added lines>` for each one the leaf adds lines to; read from the integration branch. Default empty.

slot.description: The reviewer slot being filled, e.g. reviewer-openai.

use.description: Model id of the substitute; must be a roster entry (its family comes from the roster).

scope.description: Node ids the substitution covers. Omit to cover every node; an empty list is rejected.

expires_when.description: Human-readable expiry condition, e.g. 'gpt-5.6-sol has capacity'.

expires.description: Machine-checked expiry: the substitution stops counting after this date.
